teaser: Six in the morning, before anyone else in the house is awake, and the list is already made. Life path 22 and the four letters of ESFJ meet right there, in that early list-making — a number built for structures meant to outlast one lifetime, crossed with a type built to make sure every person under that structure has a chair. Another number might sketch the plan and move to the next thing. This one checks the chair is level before the first stone goes down. What gets built here is judged less by its size than by who it was built for, and whether they ever find out.
